Welcome to my blog and my first post! There's not much going on here, just testing out how to make posts. I used Quarto (theme: vapor) to make this blog. You can learn more about how to do it on [Quarto's website-blog tutorial](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-blog.html). In the meantime, I'm going to try running a block of code on this site:

```{R}
month <- "october"

print.seasonal.drink <- function(month){
    if (month == "october"){
        print("The current seasonal drink is a Pumpkin Spice Latte.")
    }
}

print.seasonal.drink(month)
```

Cheers! :-)
